surface.name: Workers AI REST API
surface.selection_basis: Cloudflare's current REST quickstart starts with an account, creates a Workers AI API token, captures the account ID, and runs a hosted language model through cURL.

alternatives_considered.name: Workers binding
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: It requires a Worker project and deployment, while the REST route can return model output directly.

alternatives_considered.name: Dashboard playground
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: The review goal is a programmable authenticated API response.

entry_point.developer_intent: Create Workers AI REST credentials and receive output from a hosted language model.
assumed_prior_state: No Cloudflare account, Workers AI token, or account ID has been configured.
A browser and cURL are available.

documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated Workers AI REST request returns language-model output.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The JSON response has success true and result.response contains generated text.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The REST guide ends with a successful Execute AI model response and generated text.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The returned model text completes the first hosted-inference job before Worker deployment, bindings, gateway, or production controls.

prerequisites.requirement: A Workers AI API token with the required permissions.
The Cloudflare account ID and a Workers AI model name.
An HTTPS client such as cURL.

primary_path.action: Create or sign in to a Cloudflare account and open Workers AI.
primary_path.success_signal: The Workers AI page is reachable.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Account access follows Cloudflare's signup and verification flow.

primary_path.action: Select Use REST API and create a Workers AI API token.
details: The documented token template supplies the intended permissions.
primary_path.success_signal: The token is copied and stored.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: A custom token needs Workers AI Read and Edit permissions.

primary_path.action: Copy the Cloudflare account ID and select the documented model or another catalog model.
primary_path.success_signal: Both values are available for the request URL.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An invalid account or model prevents execution.

primary_path.action: POST the prompt to the account-specific Execute AI model endpoint with the Bearer token.
primary_path.input: Account ID, token, model, and prompt
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Credential, permission, account, model, quota, or request errors block output.

primary_path.action: Confirm result.response contains generated model text.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An error body or missing result does not meet the boundary.

branches.condition: The developer creates a custom API token instead of using the template.
branches.path: Grant Workers AI Read and Edit permissions explicitly.
branches.effect_on_first_success: Adds permission selection and a risk of an under-scoped token.

friction_gates.description: The API token needs Workers AI permissions.
The account ID and model name are required.

sources.title: Get started with the Workers AI REST API
sections_used: Get API token and Account ID

uncertainties.question: Which plan, free allocation, or payment state applies to a new account at first request?
uncertainties.impact: Could add a billing or quota gate.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The REST quickstart proves the API route but does not define universal new-account commercial eligibility.
